import subprocess


_FORBIDDEN_CHARS = set(";|&><`$\n\r")


def execute_command(command: str) -> str:
    """Execute a validated command and return stdout as a string, preserving its newline.

    Only allow pwd with no arguments or echo with plain whitespace-separated
    arguments. Reject empty input, all other commands, and any input containing
    ; | & > < ` $ \\n or \\r by raising ValueError. Reject echo arguments
    beginning with '-'. Uses a two-second process timeout; execution or timeout
    errors are propagated.
    """
    if not isinstance(command, str):
        raise ValueError("command must be a string")

    if not command.strip():
        raise ValueError("empty command")

    if any(ch in _FORBIDDEN_CHARS for ch in command):
        raise ValueError("command contains forbidden characters")

    tokens = command.split()
    if not tokens:
        raise ValueError("empty command")

    name = tokens[0]
    args = tokens[1:]

    if name == "pwd":
        if args:
            raise ValueError("pwd does not accept arguments")
        argv = ["pwd"]
    elif name == "echo":
        for arg in args:
            if arg.startswith("-"):
                raise ValueError("echo arguments must not begin with '-'")
        argv = ["echo", *args]
    else:
        raise ValueError("command not allowed")

    result = subprocess.run(
        argv,
        shell=False,
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        timeout=2,
        check=True,
    )
    return result.stdout
